hypothesis: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, APOE4 adheres more tightly to some recycling receptors than APOE3, impeding recycling.

paper.title: Reversal of ApoE4-induced recycling block as a novel prevention approach for Alzheimer's disease.

findings.finding_description: In a cell-free solid-phase pull-down, HEK293-secreted ApoE (0–10 µg/ml) was incubated with Apoer2-Fc ectodomain on protein-G beads. ApoE3 and ApoE4 bound Apoer2 with similar affinity and ApoE2 bound poorly. This argues against isoform-specific tighter binding at neutral pH.
findings.quote: ApoE3 and ApoE4 bind Apoer2 with similar affinity, whereas ApoE2 binding to Apoer2 is poor.
findings.summary: At neutral pH in vitro, ApoE4 does not bind Apoer2 more tightly than ApoE3; their affinities are similar.
findings.experimental_system: Cell-free pull-down: HEK293-secreted human ApoE isoforms with recombinant mouse Apoer2-Fc ectodomain

findings.finding_description: Rat primary neurons were treated with ApoE3 or ApoE4 (5 µg/ml, 3 h), then lysates were immunoprecipitated with anti-Apoer2 and blotted for ApoE. More ApoE4 than ApoE3 co-precipitated with Apoer2, which the authors read as prolonged intracellular retention of ApoE4 with its receptor.
findings.quote: The delayed recycling of Apoer2 was also apparent by the prolonged retention of cell-derived ApoE4 compared to cell-derived ApoE3 in Apoer2-containing intracellular compartments as shown by co-immunoprecipitation of neuronal lysates (Figure 2D,E).
findings.summary: More ApoE4 than ApoE3 stays associated with Apoer2 in neurons, consistent with tighter or prolonged receptor association.
findings.experimental_system: Rat primary cortical neurons treated with HEK293-secreted human ApoE3/ApoE4

findings.finding_description: In a surface biotinylation assay, neurons were pre-treated with ApoE3 or ApoE4 and then given Reelin to induce Apoer2 endocytosis. Apoer2 surface reappearance was greatly delayed with ApoE4 compared with ApoE3.
findings.quote: While Apoer2 quickly recycled in the presence of ApoE3, its reappearance on the cell surface was greatly delayed in the presence of ApoE4 (Figure 2B,C).
findings.summary: ApoE4 impairs Reelin-induced Apoer2 recycling to the neuronal surface more than ApoE3 does.
findings.experimental_system: Rat primary cortical neurons treated with HEK293-secreted human ApoE3/ApoE4 plus Reelin

findings.finding_description: In the same biotinylation assay, surface levels of the ApoE receptors Lrp1 and Ldlr, and of TfR and IR, were comparable with ApoE3 and ApoE4. This is a null result: the isoform effect on recycling did not extend to these receptors, including other ApoE receptors.
findings.quote: Other ApoE receptors, such as low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein 1 (Lrp1) and low-density lipoprotein receptor (Ldlr), as well as the endocytic receptor for transferrin (TfR) and insulin receptor (IR) exhibit comparable surface levels in the presence of ApoE3 or ApoE4.
findings.summary: ApoE4 did not alter surface levels of Lrp1, Ldlr, TfR or IR relative to ApoE3, so the effect is receptor-selective.
findings.experimental_system: Rat primary cortical neurons treated with HEK293-secreted human ApoE3/ApoE4 plus Reelin

findings.finding_description: Pre-treatment with the NHE inhibitor EMD87580, assumed to lower endosomal pH and thereby release ApoE4 from its receptor, dose-dependently restored Apoer2 surface recycling in ApoE4-treated neurons. Receptor adherence was manipulated only through a pH surrogate.
findings.quote: Increasing concentrations progressively restored normal surface recycling of Apoer2 in the presence of ApoE4 (Figure 4B,C).
findings.summary: Lowering endosomal pH with an NHE inhibitor dose-dependently rescues the ApoE4-induced Apoer2 recycling block.
findings.experimental_system: Rat primary cortical neurons treated with human ApoE4, Reelin and EMD87580

findings.finding_description: ApoE3 at 5 µg/ml also impaired Apoer2 recycling, to a small but significant extent. EMD87580 (3 µM) prevented this and completely neutralized the ApoE4 effect, indicating the ApoE3 vs ApoE4 difference is one of degree.
findings.quote: As shown in Figure 4D and E, physiological concentrations of ApoE3 (5 µg/ml) also impaired Apoer2 recycling to a small, but significant extent.
findings.summary: ApoE3 also mildly impairs Apoer2 recycling; NHE inhibition rescues the effects of both isoforms.
findings.experimental_system: Rat primary cortical neurons treated with human ApoE3/ApoE4, Reelin and EMD87580

findings.finding_description: Bafilomycin, a proton pump inhibitor that raises endosomal pH, dose-dependently reversed EMD87580's rescue of Apoer2 recycling in ApoE4-treated neurons. This supports pH dependence of the ApoE4 block.
findings.quote: Figure 4F and G show that the resulting increase of the endosomal pH reverses the correction of the ApoE4 recycling deficit by EMD87580 and results in renewed impairment of Apoer2 trafficking.
findings.summary: Raising endosomal pH re-imposes the ApoE4-induced Apoer2 recycling block.
findings.experimental_system: Rat primary cortical neurons treated with human ApoE4, Reelin, EMD87580 and bafilomycin

findings.finding_description: With partial proton pump inhibition (50 nM bafilomycin), higher EMD87580 concentrations were needed to restore Apoer2 recycling in the presence of ApoE4, shifting the dose-response curve to the right.
findings.quote: higher concentrations of EMD87580 were required to restore normal Apoer2 recycling (Figure 4H) as evident by the right-shift of the dose-response curve (Figure 4I).
findings.summary: Bafilomycin right-shifts the EMD87580 rescue curve, consistent with pH control of ApoE4 trapping.
findings.experimental_system: Rat primary cortical neurons treated with human ApoE4, Reelin, EMD87580 and 50 nM bafilomycin

findings.finding_description: Lentiviral shRNAs against NHE1 and NHE5–9 were tested in ApoE4- and Reelin-treated neurons. Only NHE6 knockdown (three shRNAs) restored Apoer2 surface expression; the other NHE shRNAs had no effect.
findings.quote: only NHE6-specific shRNAs were able to completely restore Apoer2 expression at the plasma membrane in the presence of ApoE4
findings.summary: Genetic knockdown of NHE6, but not other NHEs, rescues ApoE4-impaired Apoer2 recycling.
findings.experimental_system: Rat primary cortical neurons with lentiviral NHE shRNAs, treated with human ApoE4 and Reelin

findings.finding_description: NHE6 shRNAs (at least 90% protein knockdown) and EMD87580 restored surface expression of Apoer2 and of the glutamate receptors GluN2B, GluA1 and GluA2/3 in ApoE4-treated neurons. Scrambled shRNA had no effect.
findings.quote: EMD87580 and the NHE6-specific shRNAs completely restored Apoer2 and glutamate receptor surface expression, while the scrambled shRNA had no effect (Panel B and quantified in Panels C-F).
findings.summary: NHE6 knockdown rescues ApoE4-impaired surface recycling of Apoer2 and co-trafficked AMPA/NMDA receptors.
findings.experimental_system: Rat primary cortical neurons with lentiviral NHE6 shRNA, treated with human ApoE4 and Reelin

findings.finding_description: Primary neurons treated with ApoE4, but not ApoE3, showed increased Dab1 tyrosine phosphorylation without Reelin. The authors interpret this as ApoE4-induced Apoer2 clustering, a surrogate for altered receptor engagement.
findings.quote: ApoE4, but not ApoE3, induces phosphorylation of Dab1 independent of Reelin.
findings.summary: ApoE4 but not ApoE3 activates Apoer2 downstream signaling (pDab1), suggesting isoform-specific receptor engagement.
findings.experimental_system: Rat primary cortical neurons treated with HEK293-secreted human ApoE3/ApoE4

findings.finding_description: In hippocampal slices from ApoE4-KI mice, Reelin failed to enhance LTP, whereas it did in ApoE3-KI slices. After in vivo EMD87580 treatment, ApoE4-KI slices regained Reelin-responsive LTP. These are functional surrogates of the recycling block.
findings.quote: ApoE4-KI slices treated with EMD87580 exhibited reduced LTP (102 ± 11.9, n = 14). ApoE4-KI slices with EMD87580 show increased LTP when treated with Reelin (136.30 ± 11.87, n = 15) as compared to EMD87580 treatment alone.
findings.summary: NHE inhibition restores Reelin-enhanced LTP in ApoE4-KI hippocampus, a functional readout of the recycling block.
findings.experimental_system: Acute hippocampal slices from 2–3-month-old humanized ApoE3-KI/ApoE4-KI mice

findings.finding_description: AD brain extract suppressed LTP. Reelin rescued this in ApoE3-KI slices but not in ApoE4-KI slices; 4 h EMD87580 perfusion abolished the suppression in ApoE4-KI slices given Reelin. This is a distal functional surrogate.
findings.quote: this LTP suppression in the presence of Aβ and Reelin in ApoE4 slices was completely abolished when the slices were perfused with EMD87580 for 4 hr prior to LTP induction.
findings.summary: NHE inhibition restores Reelin protection against Aβ-induced LTP suppression in ApoE4-KI slices.
findings.experimental_system: Acute hippocampal slices from 2–3-month-old ApoE3-KI/ApoE4-KI mice with human AD brain extract
